notes.title: Plans Moving Forward - Content Updates:
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who's played the game! It's been a crazy feeling actually publishing one for the first time.

We have sold over 50 copies in the first 3-4 days of the game being out with no real advertising.

I have a lot of ideas for new content, and a few small new mechanics/features I'd like to add - But I am waiting to see how things go over the next couple of weeks before getting started on them.

I'm trying to be a bit more practical with my time - And for now it seems more worth it to focus on the next project - But if Space Escape gets any tiny amount of traction, or we get some people letting us know they'd really like more content - Then I'll drop everything and start working on free content updates for the foreseeable future.

Not sure if anyone will even see or read this - But I figured I'd share where we're at with things just in case there's someone out there who is really enjoying the game and wondering what's up.

Thanks again for the support,
Gage
